# Shortcut: update job

Bind **VERB=`update`**, **ARTIFACT=`job`**, then run the shared engine at `.github/aid/templates/shortcut-engine.md`. The engine scaffolds the flattened Lite work (feature-001 structure), authors `REQUIREMENTS.md` -- whose `§ 11` feature section carries the technical specification -- then the task `DETAIL.md` files, with reduced capture. It writes no SPEC.md and no PLAN.md: one feature and one delivery means nothing to sequence, and the execution graph is derived from each task's `**Depends on:**` field. It runs the per-document Grading Gates (feature-004) and halts at the FR-10 approval gate. It never executes. This shortcut's `default_type`/`group` are its row in `.github/aid/templates/shortcut-catalog.yml`.
